rule.name: SharedTempPathInTest
rule.message: This test writes, deletes or hands to a process a temp path that every run builds the same way: a fixed name under java.io.tmpdir or /tmp, or one whose only varying part is the process id. Tests that run at the same time (JUnit parallel execution, forked test JVMs, a second build) then share the file, and one overwrites or deletes the file the other uses. Write inside a @TempDir directory, or create the file with Files.createTempFile or Files.createTempDirectory.
